relevant_files.purpose: Full pipeline: reads a manually downloaded .xls course-table export (via xlrd), locates the day-of-week header row and period-label column by scanning cell text, splits each cell's multi-line lesson string into name/subtitle/weeks/sections/location by line index, expands week ranges, and writes an .ics calendar. The QiangZhi connection is offline only: the user logs into http://jwxt.wit.edu.cn/jsxsd in a browser and clicks 打印 to download the .xls.

protocol_approach: No network protocol at all: the repo never calls any 教务 endpoint; the user manually exports the QiangZhi timetable as .xls from jwxt.wit.edu.cn/jsxsd via the print button, and main.py parses the spreadsheet offline with xlrd. Grid semantics are auto-detected, not hard-coded: cells containing 星期一..星期日 mark the day header (row_start=row+1), cells containing both 第 and 节 mark the period column (col_start=col+1), and the lesson cell text is split on newlines with positional access (lesson[0]=name, lesson[2]=week line, lesson[3]=location, lesson[4]=section line). Weeks are parsed with a bare \d\d? scan of the week line: two numbers = one contiguous range, four numbers = two ranges; there is NO 单周/双周 (odd/even) logic and no modulo filtering.
exact_regex_or_code_snippet:
pattern2 = re.compile(r'\d\d?')
w = pattern2.findall(lesson[2])
order = pattern1.findall(lesson[4])
order_start, order_end = int(order[0]), int(order[1])
if len(w) == 2:
    availWeeks = list(range(int(w[0]), int(w[1]) + 1))
elif len(w) == 4:
    availWeeks = list(range(int(w[0]), int(w[1]) + 1)) + list(range(int(w[2]), int(w[3]) + 1))
verdict_reason: Confirmed QiangZhi-family (武汉工程大学 jwxt.wit.edu.cn/jsxsd, README self-describes as 强智) but the parsing target is an offline .xls export, not the xskb_list.do endpoint nor .kbcontent HTML cells, and it lacks 单周/双周 odd/even semantics, so it neither confirms nor contradicts Sleepy's QiangZhi HTTP parsing claims.

sleepy_claim_check.强智 xskb_list.do + .kbcontent 解析形态: differs vs this repo — this repo has zero HTTP code and no xskb_list.do or .kbcontent references anywhere in main.py; its only overlap with Sleepy is the QiangZhi vendor identity and the week-range + section-coordinate concept
